verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.incident.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and links a markdown bundle of the Help center (456 pages), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs. That is backed by first-party MCP server documentation and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec referenced in the API docs. Missing for 10: the llms.txt index is sparse (a single Help center entry, with no separate API-reference or MCP sections), no llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance is evidenced, the probed OpenAPI paths returned 404, and there is no independent corroboration of agents using these docs.
